# Journalism Statistics

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on statistical calculations.

## API
- [addClusters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#addclusters): addClusters function
- [addMahalanobisDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#addmahalanobisdistance): addMahalanobisDistance function
- [addZScore](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#addzscore): addZScore function
- [euclidianDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#euclidiandistance): euclidianDistance function
- [generateCirPath](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#generatecirpath): generateCirPath function
- [generateGbmPath](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#generategbmpath): generateGbmPath function
- [getCholeskyMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getcholeskymatrix): getCholeskyMatrix function
- [getCirParameters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getcirparameters): getCirParameters function
- [getCorrelatedShocks](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getcorrelatedshocks): getCorrelatedShocks function
- [getCorrelationMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getcorrelationmatrix): getCorrelationMatrix function
- [getCovarianceMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getcovariancematrix): getCovarianceMatrix function
- [getGbmParameters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getgbmparameters): getGbmParameters function
- [getMahalanobisDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getmahalanobisdistance): getMahalanobisDistance function
- [getSampleSizeMean](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getsamplesizemean): getSampleSizeMean function
- [getSampleSizeProportion](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#getsamplesizeproportion): getSampleSizeProportion function
- [invertMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#invertmatrix): invertMatrix function
- [performChiSquaredGoodnessOfFitTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performchisquaredgoodnessoffittest): performChiSquaredGoodnessOfFitTest function
- [performChiSquaredIndependenceTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performchisquaredindependencetest): performChiSquaredIndependenceTest function
- [performPairedTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performpairedttest): performPairedTTest function
- [performTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performttest): performTTest function
- [performTwoSampleTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performtwosamplettest): performTwoSampleTTest function
- [performZTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#performztest): performZTest function
- [stepCir](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#stepcir): stepCir function
- [stepGbm](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/llm.md#stepgbm): stepGbm function
